CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_laundry_bag_lines(task_id_param uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id uuid, warehouse_id uuid, quantity numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH task_property AS (
    SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.propiedad_id AS property_id, t.sede_id AS task_sede_id, p.*
    FROM public.tasks t
    JOIN public.properties p ON p.id = t.propiedad_id
    WHERE t.id = task_id_param
  ), sources AS (
    SELECT r.product_id, r.warehouse_id, r.quantity_per_cleaning AS quantity
    FROM public.stock_property_consumption_rules r
    JOIN task_property tp ON tp.property_id = r.property_id
    JOIN public.stock_products sp ON sp.id = r.product_id AND sp.is_active
    JOIN public.stock_categories sc ON sc.id = sp.category_id AND sc.kind = 'laundry'::public.stock_item_kind
    WHERE r.is_active AND r.quantity_per_cleaning > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.product_id, m.warehouse_id,
      CASE m.property_field
        WHEN 'numero_sabanas' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_sabanas, 0)
        WHEN 'numero_sabanas_pequenas' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_sabanas_pequenas, 0)
        WHEN 'numero_sabanas_suite' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_sabanas_suite, 0)
        WHEN 'numero_toallas_grandes' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_toallas_grandes, 0)
        WHEN 'numero_toallas_pequenas' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_toallas_pequenas, 0)
        WHEN 'numero_alfombrines' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_alfombrines, 0)
        WHEN 'numero_fundas_almohada' THEN COALESCE(tp.numero_fundas_almohada, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END * m.multiplier
    FROM public.stock_property_field_mappings m
    JOIN task_property tp ON tp.task_sede_id = m.sede_id
    JOIN public.stock_products sp ON sp.id = m.product_id AND sp.is_active
    JOIN public.stock_categories sc ON sc.id = sp.category_id AND sc.kind = 'laundry'::public.stock_item_kind
    WHERE m.is_active
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_property_consumption_rules r
        WHERE r.property_id = tp.property_id AND r.product_id = m.product_id AND r.is_active
      )
  )
  SELECT s.product_id,
    COALESCE(s.warehouse_id, tp.default_stock_warehouse_id, (
      SELECT w.id FROM public.stock_warehouses w
      WHERE w.sede_id = tp.task_sede_id AND w.is_default AND w.is_active
      LIMIT 1
    )) AS warehouse_id,
    SUM(s.quantity)::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS quantity
  FROM sources s
  CROSS JOIN task_property tp
  WHERE s.quantity > 0
  GROUP BY s.product_id, COALESCE(s.warehouse_id, tp.default_stock_warehouse_id, (
    SELECT w.id FROM public.stock_warehouses w
      WHERE w.sede_id = tp.task_sede_id AND w.is_default AND w.is_active
    LIMIT 1
  ));
$function$
